name: Yukawa Grandpa
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c12294]Ryou[/url]'s grandpa. He is an old man with lots of wisdom on life matters. He is an owner of Yukawa dojo and Ryou used to train her martial arts skills there. [spoiler][url=https://vndb.org/c12295]Chouji[/url] also stayed there at one point in time during his childhood and it was then that Ryou's grandpa suggested to him that he marries his granddaughter Ryou later on when they both get older.[/spoiler]
